FROM President p
JOIN PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
WHERE p.StateBorn IN (
    SELECT ps.StateBorn
    FROM President ps
    JOIN PresidentHolding psh ON ps.PresidentName = psh.PresidentName
    WHERE ps.PartyName <> p.PartyName

    SELECT AVG(MIN(psh2.YearEnd - psh2.YearHolding))
    FROM President ps2
    JOIN PresidentHolding psh2 ON ps2.PresidentName = psh2.PresidentName
    WHERE ps2.StateBorn = p.StateBorn AND ps2.PartyName <> p.PartyName
)

WITH RECURSIVE VPChain AS (
    SELECT PresidentName, VicePresidentName
    FROM PresidentHolding
    WHERE VicePresidentName IN (SELECT PresidentName FROM President)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT PH.PresidentName, PH.VicePresidentName
    FROM PresidentHolding PH
    JOIN VPChain VC ON PH.VicePresidentName = VC.PresidentName
)

FROM VPChain A

SELECT 
    p.PresidentName,
    ph.YearHolding,
    COALESCE(pp.PartyName, 'None') AS PreviousParty,
    ph.PartyName AS CurrentParty
FROM 
    President p
JOIN 
    PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
LEFT JOIN 
    Party pp ON p.PartyName = pp.PartyName
WHERE 
    (ph.YearHolding, ph.YearEnd) IN (
        SELECT YearHolding, MAX(YearEnd)
        FROM PresidentHolding
        GROUP BY YearHolding
    )
ORDER BY 
    ph.YearHolding ASC,
    ph.YearEnd DESC;
```

SELECT 
    p.PresidentName,
    ph.YearHolding,
    COALESCE(pp.PartyName, 'None') AS PreviousParty,
    ph.PartyName AS CurrentParty
FROM 
    President p
JOIN 
    PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
LEFT JOIN 
    Party pp ON p.PartyName = pp.PartyName
WHERE 
    (ph.YearHolding, ph.YearEnd) IN (
        SELECT YearHolding, MAX(YearEnd)
        FROM PresidentHolding
        GROUP BY YearHolding
    )
ORDER BY 
    ph.YearHolding ASC,
    ph.YearEnd DESC;
```

FROM President p1

    SELECT PresidentName, VicePresidentName
    FROM PresidentHolding
    WHERE VicePresidentName IN (SELECT PresidentName FROM President)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT PH.PresidentName, PH.VicePresidentName
